description: Human Microbiome Research CDM — machine-readable schema (DRAFT 0.1.0, design phase). Companion to docs/cdm_design/cdm_schema_proposal.md. This file records the proposed table/column layout with source bindings at table level; see cdm_field_crosswalk.csv-family (cdm_field_crosswalk.md) for per-field bindings. PK patterns: template/cdm/human_microbiome_cdm.schema.json.

bioproject.note: dual-direction BP↔paper index; asymmetries flagged CONFLICTING

full_text_availability.note: kept separate from completeness/parse status (paper.schema.json rule)

text_version_id.note: canonical text geometry reference for all evidence offsets

section_id_original.note: section_id does not exist as a single source field

section_text_original.note: THE canonical evidence geometry; offsets index this text

run_id.source: processing_events.jsonl:run_id + run manifests (SLURM job id / manifest id)
run_id.note: PROVISIONAL flag for in-flight jobs (cv-link 28607619, llm-ner-body 28607825, termpipe-v1 28608065, stage53/54 28607588)

is_provisional.source: derived: job state at ingest time

mode.source: derived: section-level vs paper-level vs abstract-level
mode.note: same model family in different modes = different runs; lineage edge recorded

coverage_stats.source: run summary/manifest JSONs (papers covered, rows parsed, yields)

run_id.source: derived: run registry join (run manifests: SLURM job id)

mention_id.note: content-hash includes extraction_run_id → models never merge

occurrence_key.note: extractor-independent span; competing models share the occurrence, never the mention

geometry_note.note: pubtator3 rows (original + backfill 28608086): offsets 0,0 paper-level geometry, recorded on the run

section_id.note: join = section.section_id_original (sections have no section_id field)

n_papers.note: first-record oddity (2092, HMPAPER_000001-5) predates corpus_v2 IDs — inspect at ingest

concept_code.note: verified external ids only — never fabricated

llm_status.note: LLM provenance block carried in full, never summarized away

notes.note: machine-extracted, UNVERIFIED — candidate for human curation

effect_measure.note: ~1,088 p-shaped effect_estimate quirk documented, not fixed

extraction_run_id.note: derived from extractor + source run; orphan check
extraction_run_id.source: derived: from extractor_model_and_version + run registry (orphan check)

catalogue_linkage.note: catalogue projection adds study-level linkage; both row sets retained

relation.pk_pattern: TBD (triple patterns pending stage 53/54 + 56; propose termpipeline hash style)

review_status.source: new (CDM-native); value originates only from the named CDM mechanism (state machine)

recovery_limitation.default: leave-K-out estimates ~28% full-triple recovery — recorded as limitation, not success
recovery_limitation.source: derived: leave-K-out evaluation of triple stage (~28% full-triple recovery)

target_entity.source: new (CDM-native); value originates only from the named CDM mechanism (reviewer input)

target_id.source: new (CDM-native); value originates only from the named CDM mechanism (reviewer input)

review_type.source: new (CDM-native); value originates only from the named CDM mechanism

reviewer.source: reviewer identity — the only ACCEPTED/REJECTED mechanism

review_date.source: new (CDM-native); value originates only from the named CDM mechanism

decision.source: new (CDM-native); value originates only from the named CDM mechanism

notes.source: new (CDM-native); value originates only from the named CDM mechanism

target_id.note: paper id, section key, run id, or entity id

run_id.source: derived: validation run registry (validation_per_paper has no run_id)

known_issues.note: automated checks raise REVIEW_REQUIRED; never resolve it

metrics.note: agreement only — no accuracy until adjudication; numbers never flow back to extraction rows

coverage_restrictions.note: pubtator3 comparisons restricted to common papers (300 pre-backfill; 434 after 28608086)
coverage_restrictions.source: derived: paper-coverage intersection of compared runs (300 pre-backfill; 434 with 28608086 backfill)

captures_runs.source: derived: run ids captured by the release snapshot
